Compute all same-source one-step peaks arising from overlapping (including nested) occurrences of any pair of left sides. Each critical pair is joinable iff its two descendants share at least one reachable normal form under the same rules. Because every rule strictly shortens finite words, termination is proved by exact length. Then all critical pairs joinable is equivalent to confluence of the entire finite string rewrite relation (critical pair criterion + Newman's lemma). Return CONFLUENT or a concrete NONCONFLUENT witness: source, two branches, and separately reachable normal-form sets with empty intersection. Wording does not imply that a nonconfluent ruleset lacks individual common normal forms for other starting words.

Обмежений сучасний контракт, натхнений Maling MIT AI Memo 10 (1959), а не твердження про дослівну транскрипцію мемо; Core-vs-library мінімальність лишається на власниковому перегляді.

For TWO finite ground, ordered, free first-order constructor terms (not D2 executable expressions), return their least general generalization modulo alpha-renaming and two substitutions which reconstruct each term EXACTLY. Identical atoms and equal-name/equal-arity constructors are retained. Every incompatible ordered pair of subterms becomes one fresh hole; equal ordered disagreement pairs reuse the SAME hole, even in disjoint branches. A different arity or constructor is a disagreement. Fresh holes are numbered by first depth-first left-to-right appearance. A non-ground input, binder, improper term or unbounded depth is BLOCKED. This operation is not unification and never claims a physical .sens semantics.
